title: Alien reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Alien body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='18' ry='22' fill='#6EE8A0'/>
  <!-- Alien head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='15' ry='17' fill='#7CF5AE'/>
  <!-- Head highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='24' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#A8FFCE'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='32' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#2A1A4A'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='32' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#2A1A4A'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='31' rx='1.6' ry='2.4' fill='#C9FFE4'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='31' rx='1.6' ry='2.4' fill='#C9FFE4'/>
  <!-- Antennae -->
  <line x1='42' y1='16' x2='37' y2='7' stroke='#59D48C' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='6' r='3' fill='#FFD65A'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='16' x2='63' y2='7' stroke='#59D48C' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='6' r='3' fill='#FFD65A'/>
  <!-- Book: open, held in front -->
  <g>
    <!-- left page -->
    <path d='M50 52 L30 57 L30 74 L50 70 Z' fill='#FFF4D6'/>
    <!-- right page -->
    <path d='M50 52 L70 57 L70 74 L50 70 Z' fill='#FFE9B8'/>
    <!-- page lines left -->
    <line x1='34' y1='60' x2='47' y2='57.5' stroke='#B9A47A' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='34' y1='64' x2='47' y2='61.8' stroke='#B9A47A' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='34' y1='68' x2='47' y2='66.1' stroke='#B9A47A' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <!-- page lines right -->
    <line x1='53' y1='57.5' x2='66' y2='60' stroke='#D9C48F' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='53' y1='61.8' x2='66' y2='64' stroke='#D9C48F' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='53' y1='66.1' x2='66' y2='68' stroke='#D9C48F' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <!-- book spine -->
    <line x1='50' y1='51' x2='50' y2='70' stroke='#F2B14A' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Alien hands holding book -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='59' r='4.5' fill='#7CF5AE'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='59' r='4.5' fill='#7CF5AE'/>
  <!-- Arms -->
  <line x1='36' y1='56' x2='30' y2='59' stroke='#6EE8A0' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='64' y1='56' x2='70' y2='59' stroke='#6EE8A0' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M46 42 Q50 46 54 42' stroke='#2A8A55' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
